# AgenticTrust Next.js starter
> Next.js App Router boilerplate with a placeholder did:web identity. Replace REPLACE_ME before you publish the site.

Domain: REPLACE_ME.example

## Services
- Home page (/)
- Health API (GET /api/health)

## Identity
- DID: did:web:REPLACE_ME.example
- Manifest: https://REPLACE_ME.example/.well-known/did.json

## Trust
Verified by AgenticTrust. Registry: Trustflow Systems (https://trustflow.systems).
Agents should call verifyDomain before tool invocation.
